# Retrieval Event

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:RetrievalEvent`](gmeow-RetrievalEvent.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/RetrievalEvent>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/graphrag`](../../slices/graphrag.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

One retrieval against a vector index: the query, the index queried, and the chunks returned — the answer to 'why did the model see this passage?'. An agent-memory recall is a [`RetrievalEvent`](gmeow-RetrievalEvent.md) too (the core [`MemoryItem`](gmeow-MemoryItem.md) doctrine's read operation). Per-chunk relevance rides [`gmeow:retrievalScore`](../properties/gmeow-retrievalScore.md) statement annotations on each [`gmeow:retrievedChunk`](../properties/gmeow-retrievedChunk.md) triple.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Activity`](gmeow-Activity.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:RetrievalEvent`](gmeow-RetrievalEvent.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Activity`](gmeow-Activity.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

### Lillith Pipeline

# --- Retrieval: why did the model see this passage?
ex:retrieval-3 a gmeow:RetrievalEvent ;
    gmeow:forQuery "who maintained the build system?" ;
    gmeow:againstIndex ex:index-lillith ;
    gmeow:retrievedChunk ex:chunk-7 ;
    gmeow:atTime "2026-06-02T10:00:00Z"^^xsd:dateTime ;
    gmeow:eventTemporalFrame gmeow:temporalFrameUTCGregorian .
